what: When a page opens, the background-color curtain lifts in .45s, and clicking a link to another page on the same site covers it in .35s before navigating — a seamless transition between pages

options.cover: Time (s) for the curtain to cover after a link is clicked, default 0.35 — the next page is only called once fully covered, so navigation is delayed by this much
options.reveal: Seconds for the cover to lift on an opened page, default 0.45 — starts .05s later and is fully visible at .05 + reveal seconds (default .5s)
options.[data-fx-part=top] (on the link): Scrolls smoothly to the top without moving to another page
options.ease: Curve — both cover and reveal use this (GSAP name or ”0.16,1,0.3,1”). Default cover power2.in · reveal power2.out
options.delay: Delay (seconds) before the cover lifts on an opened page, default 0.05
options.look: split — two sheets, top and bottom (contrast stage color), close and open (Brand A type) · centre — a single background-color sheet opens from the center vertical line to both sides and covers (Brand B: cover default .9 · power3.inOut, on the opened page reveal default 0 — visible right away). rise — a single accent-color sheet rises with the bottom edge as the axis to cover (scaleY 0→1) and on the opened page lifts away with the top edge as the axis (Brand C: cover and lift .6 · power3.inOut · wait 0). If not set, a single background-color sheet fades in to cover · layers — a curtain of three overlapping sheets: accent, light accent and contrast stage colors. On press they unfold from the bottom sheet at .05s intervals with the left edge as the axis to cover, and on the opened page they fold left from the top sheet at .05s intervals to lift away (Brand D: cover and lift .6 · power3.inOut · wait 0). On phones (768 and below) it uses scaleY, with .1s intervals when covering. The three sheet colors are --fx-layer-1·2·3 (style) · slide — a single background-color sheet pushes up from below to cover (translateY 100%→0) and on the opened page slides straight up and away (Brand E: cover and lift 1 · cubic-bezier(.64,.04,.35,1) · wait 0) · circle — an accent-color curtain covers as a circle from one corner (at) over .7s expo.inOut, with the mark turning in at −90° and .7x (after .35s, .5s expo.out). On the opened page the mark disappears in .25s and the circle shrinks to the opposite corner (to) over .8s (after .15s — Brand F)
options.stagger: look: split — gap in seconds between the two sheets, default cover .04 · uncover .03 · look: layers — gap between sheets (default .05, phone cover .1)
options.wait: With load, the open page’s curtain is lifted after window load (fonts·images too) — for when a white curtain acts as the loading screen without a loader, like the original site. Otherwise it lifts immediately when the script runs.
options.reveal-ease: Curve for only the reveal on the opened page (GSAP name or ”0.16,1,0.3,1”) — if empty, it follows ease. Brand: cover expo.inOut · reveal power4.out
options.at · to: look: circle covering corner · revealing corner (clip-path coordinates), default ‹100% 0%› · ‹0% 100%›
options.[data-fx-part=mark] (look: circle): (if present) marker centered in the curtain (child) — the part moves into the curtain
options.--fx-veil: (css variable, body style) Default type curtain color — default background color. brand is var(--kf-contrast-bg) (dark curtain)
options.shade: End darkness (0~1) of the shade cast by the contrast stage color (--kf-contrast-bg) laid behind the sheet while it covers — darkens from 0 with the same length and curve as the covering. Default 0 (none) · brand: .46 while the white sheet rises

use: <body data-fx="page-veil" data-fx-page-veil="cover: 0.12; reveal: 0.15"> — Default is the original length (cover .35 s · clear .5 s) · brand type: data-fx-page-veil="cover: .35; reveal: .5; ease: power1.out; delay: 0"
